fieldNotes._locationError: FACILITY COULD NOT BE POSITIVELY LOCATED. The roster address (4500 Renaissance Pkwy, Cleveland OH 44128) and the roster lat/lng (41.437354, -81.493674) are WRONG for this facility - 4500 Renaissance Pkwy is confirmed by web research (LoopNet/BBB) to be Great Lakes Petroleum Co. / Northeast Lubricants in Warrensville Heights, NOT a FedEx facility.
fieldNotes._realFacility: The actual facility is the FedEx Ground automated regional 'mini-hub' in RICHFIELD OH 44286 (between Cleveland and Akron), documented at 3245 Henry Rd / 3900 Brecksville Rd. Per Truckinginfo/FleetOwner: 229,000 sq ft, latest camera-based package-sorting technology, capacity for 144 pickup-and-delivery vans, consolidated four older sites (three Cleveland-metro, one Akron). It sits in Richfield's planned 'Crossroads District' (550 acres at Wheatley Rd x Brecksville Rd, bounded by I-271/I-77); the FedEx parcel forms the southern boundary of the 'South Wheatley' focus area.
fieldNotes._searchEffort: Probed Richfield village, the Wheatley/Brecksville intersection, the South Wheatley triangle, and the Brecksville/Richfield-Township border industrial area (z15-z18) and walked Street View. The South Wheatley zone is largely undeveloped/wooded. Candidate large cross-dock distribution buildings exist near the Brecksville/Richfield border (~41.276,-81.615) but NONE showed FedEx branding or the distinctive ~144-van FedEx Ground P&D fleet, so the exact building could not be confirmed. The placeholder coords point to that candidate vicinity.
fieldNotes._recommendation: Roster address/coords need correction to the Richfield 44286 location (3245 Henry Rd / 3900 Brecksville Rd). A re-audit with corrected coordinates is required. All classification fields left at safe defaults and flagged uncertain.
